//: Test files that may contain /tmp, and why it is safe on native Windows (where /tmp does not exist). Checked by scripts/tmp-residue-check.mjs in CI. opaque: every /tmp is a string that never reaches the disk. posix-only: the tests using /tmp are skipped on win32. sun_path: /tmp is used on POSIX for short Unix-socket paths; Windows uses os.tmpdir().
